description: 한국환경연구원_국토환경성평가_홍수관리구역 [flood] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국환경연구원. 법령에 의하여 환경보전을 위해 지정한 입지의 타당성 검토가 필요한 지역·지구·구역 등을 평가하여 환경정보로 나타낸 법제적 평가항목. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국환경연구원. Its tags are 국토환경성평가, 법제적 평가, 법제적 평가항목, 환경기상. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2024-12-04 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
